analysis_scope: Saved records only; Python standard library; no imported experiment code, model forward, simulator transitions, training or web

independent_bootstrap.implementation: Python random.Random(814117),4000 whole-rule draws; ratio-of-sums; linear percentile interpolation. Different RNG stream from production NumPy PCG64; same unit/estimator.

first_divergence_attribution.definition: First differing command on paired state_guard/fact_guard k0 trajectories with identical prior query prefix; classify evidence already sufficient to rule out state_guard candidate. Source-only/query-only names mean sufficient under that evidence but not the other; both is redundant sufficiency, combined-only requires the intersection.

dedup_failure_identical_input.interpretation: Revisited exact canonical-history/state/goal means deterministic greedy reevaluation cannot exit without input change; confirms a local absorbing-loop mechanism, not planning or posterior beliefs.

checks: All episode keys unique and pair keys/goal match
All production paired point estimates match recomputation
All actual/capped/source/retry/reset costs match saved records
All event flags independently reconstruct from prior public receipts with standard-library parent sets
No fact_guard known-impossible or completed-action command
Dedup complete rollout endpoints equal across k for each eligible pair
First-divergence fact mask explains changed command on shared prefix
